Boston Beer Taps Operating Chief Hodges to Be Next CEO

Phil Hodges will succeed founder Jim Koch, who is stepping down after returning to the helm last year

By

Boston Beer Co. SAM -2.24 % decrease; down pointing triangle named Chief Operating Officer Phil Hodges as its new chief executive.

Hodges will succeed founder Jim Koch, who is stepping down after returning to the helm last year.
